notes.text: קטו: gives Shabbat 115b; the earlier 116a suggestion is not adopted. Earlier machine OCR had קמו:, not a verified printed alternative. No named edition is independently checked.

The added Tosefta reference gives no chapter or halakhah, and no chapter 13 is supplied. The leading “And” remains. The source article and Tanna classification are preserved; the abbreviated title remains R'.
